public_items.name: DataClass
doc: Explicit classification at the storage API boundary (SPEC §4.7).
This is deliberately a closed enum.  Storage validates the combinations
involving this value before it starts catalog, key, or filesystem I/O; it
does not inspect user content to infer a classification.

public_items.name: InstanceId
doc: Stable identity of one storage instance.  A stamp is meaningful only with
this identity and must never be treated as a globally ordered value.
attrs: #[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, PartialOrd, Ord, Hash)]

methods.name: probe

public_items.name: MIN_ERASE_RESERVE_BYTES
doc: Capacity reserved for erase progress, consumer retention, filesystem
metadata headroom, and the dedicated purge scratch slots (SPEC §16).

public_items.name: CATALOG_ROLLOVER_MIN_BYTES
public_items.signature: pub const CATALOG_ROLLOVER_MIN_BYTES: u64 = 8 * MIB as u64

public_items.name: AnchorStrength
doc: Strength is explicit because a local file prevents neither rollback of a
copied volume nor two restored hosts from writing concurrently.

public_items.name: ClockReading
doc: Injected time sample. `durable_utc_millis` is the persisted UTC high-water
mark; adapters must never move it backwards. `skew` is fail-closed when
the observed wall clock is implausibly far from that mark.

methods.name: deadline_utc_millis
doc: Returns UTC usable for durable deadlines, rejecting clock rollback and
adapter-reported skew. Monotonic process time remains usable for
elapsed-duration measurement while this check fails.

methods.name: advance
methods.signature: fn advance(&self, expect: AnchorValue, next: AnchorValue) -> Result<(), Error>
doc: Monoton; bei verlorenem Wettlauf Error::CasLost.

methods.name: read
doc: Returns monotone and UTC time plus the durable clock floor.
Storage uses monotonic time for process-local expiry. Durable deadlines
must fail closed when `skew` is `Uncertain`.

methods.name: advance_utc_floor
methods.signature: fn advance_utc_floor(&self, expect_millis: u64, next_millis: u64) -> Result<(), Error>
doc: Durably advances the UTC high-water mark with compare-and-swap
semantics. A lower value is rejected; a lost race returns `CasLost`.

methods.name: verify_four_eyes
methods.signature: fn verify_four_eyes( &self, requester: &Principal, approver: &Principal, proof: &FourEyesProof, ) -> Result<(), Error>
doc: Verifies the policy-layer proof for a lift.  The core rejects equal
principals before calling this port; providers must not log the opaque
values they receive.

public_items.name: ResourcePermit
doc: A single successful reservation. Dropping it returns exactly the reserved
amount to the originating budget; permits are intentionally not cloneable.

public_items.name: MetricName
doc: Fixed metric catalog from SPEC §16.

public_items.name: MetricLabel
doc: A single bounded label. The enum prevents identifiers and arbitrary text
from entering metric dimensions.

methods.name: record
methods.signature: fn record(&self, name: MetricName, sample: MetricSample, labels: &[MetricLabel])
doc: Must be nonblocking. Names and labels are restricted to SPEC §16's
closed catalog, so call sites cannot attach identifiers or payloads.

identifiers, tokens, keys, or arbitrary strings.
